geometryMethod: Reviewed visible client/frame borders after QMP frame/corner drags at native1280x800 display. Restored compositor-maximized reopen through observed titlebar restore control. Requested coordinates alone are not size proof.

settingsSavedEmpty.observations: Prominent Add S3 destination and Save locally. Inactive destination/credential cards hidden. Actual Add reveals draft cards; Cancel closes normally and accepted empty revision remains identical at both native sizes.

settingsConfigured.observations: Simple S3 bucket/region/URL and credential forms fit both native sizes. First Advanced expansion displays Capture, Destinations, Shortcuts, Preferences with footer visible. Native Tab and ShiftTab enter Capture Save locally, Shortcuts help then input, Preferences checkbox and return to navigation. Bucket synthetic-ui-onlyd and retention3 survive collapse/expand and resize; Cancel restores accepted bucket synthetic-ui-only and indefinite retention.

historyLifecycle.observations: Current candidate History opened with eleven real local-only matrix entries, normally closed, reopened, normally closed. No deletion/clear invoked.

activityLifecycle.observations: Current candidate Activity opened with twelve actual matrix operations including three cancelled region entries, normally closed/reopened/closed. No retry/cancel operation invoked.

renderedTray.unlock: Root typed protected local password through visible masked VNC; actual unlocked image inspected by reviewer. No bypass or credential read.
